text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492.** This is from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their bay-assignment texts at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the next morning's 04:00 shift checked in without problems.
2. **#4419.** This is from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`), which has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. The note says it went up to tier-2 support for firmware testing. It doesn't say whether it was fixed.

I looked at all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. The other four have no QFL ticket numbers: the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal note mention QFL but no tickets, and the two Central notes are about other accounts. Watch out for "Quarendon Freightways" (one "r"), which turns up in Marcus's notes. It's a different company that isn't our customer, so I left it out.
